newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour loses by-election to Conservatives.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour loses by-election to Conservatives.

text.p: Britain's opposition Conservative party on Friday retained the seat of Uxbridge, west London, in a by-election that marked the first real setback for the ruling Labour party since it swept to power three months ago.
Conservative candidate John Randall defeated Labour's Andy Slaughter by 3,766 votes to reduce Prime Minister Tony Blair's parliamentary majority to 178.
It was the first time the Conservatives had won a by-election since 1989.
